Origin: RF Communications, a Rochester radio maker acquired by Harris in 1969; Harris merged with L3 in 2019. fix.ctx: Corporate headquarters of L3Harris Technologies, formed by the 2019 merger of Harris Corporation and L3 Technologies; about 47,000 employees (2025). Three reporting segments as of 2026: Space & Mission Systems, Communications & Spectrum Dominance, and Missile Solutions - the last built on Aerojet Rocketdyne (acquired July 2023), the solid-rocket-motor maker, consolidating much of US missile propulsion in one prime; in Jan 2026 it agreed to sell a majority of Aerojet's space propulsion business. On 17 Aug 2026, after a board-led investigation found that chairman and CEO Christopher Kubasik's conduct was inconsistent with the Code of Conduct, he and the company agreed to end his employment, without severance; the 8-K says the conduct did not involve financial reporting, controls, customer relationships or operational performance. Sam Mehta became CEO and Lewis Hay III independent chairman.
